== Crossover research, part 2 (Oct 2026) ==
* '''Sources checked:''' LOTR-TCG Wiki Worlds 2002, 2003, 2023 and 2024 (no pages for 2004–2007/2010); TLHH threads 8581, 12100, 12101, 6620, 12103, 12104 and 5072; DGMA archive pages 177, 471, 490, 973, 974 and 977.
* '''Added:''' [[Alex Tennet]], [[Clint Hays]], [[Dominic Gaudreault]], [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], [[Kyle Craft]], [[Doug Faust]], [[Brad Eier]], [[Yannick Lapointe]], [[Hayes Hunter]] and [[Maximilien Bouchard]], plus [[Brian Fred]] for 2003–2005.
* '''Skipped as ambiguous:''' Michael Dalton (2003 champion) vs. [[Mike Dalton]] (one 1999 Decipher deck); Chris Thompson (2007 co-champion) vs. [[Chris Thompson]]; Dan Clark, Steve Jones, Ryan Jones and Lee Clark (common names). The 2023/2024 GEMP events list handles only, and none matched.
* '''Not placings:''' [[Mark Tuttle]] and "Mike Girard" gave colour commentary for the 2003 final.
* '''Photos:''' the Origins 2002 top 16 photo names Hays, Faust, Craft, Gaudreault and Eier, but the caption's left-to-right order doesn't map cleanly onto two rows, so no crops were taken from it. Portraits came from the labelled 2002 Worlds top 16 grid instead.
* '''Missing:''' 2004/2005 Worlds dates and venues; 2005 places beyond top 16; 2006/2007 lists.
